Before conversion staging, the candidate compares every retained current wiki/papers, wiki/code and wiki/concepts path from the audited byte snapshot with prospective compiler pages. Any omission raises SOURCE_PUBLICATION_UNSUPPORTED_CHANGE at /compiled_pages with exit code 75. The check is conversion-local and does not alter the shared publication helper.

The mixed report binds one unrelated provisional legacy row whose reviewed_at key was absent. Conversion adds only reviewed_at:null to that row; text, assessment, confidence, evidence, owner location, notes and supersedes remain byte-equivalent.

The mixed probe's changed-path audit rejects replacements of pre-existing raw captures, derived artifacts, review events and operation receipts, and rejects changes to old wiki/code pages. Its final receipt audit is receipt_backed.

The prior taxonomy reproduction remains immutable as source-conversion-taxonomy-retirement-r1-result.json, SHA-256 ccdc6d41c481b96e2e8120fadf3b38537d6c307f9831357d451ab60a1ba50302; it records the pre-R2 SOURCE_PUBLICATION_INVALID /compiled_pages ordering gap and an unchanged Vault.
